headline: Quiet day: Memphis rejects a data center pause but tightens rules
body: A quiet day. Memphis City Council split 6-6 on a 12-month data center moratorium, so it failed, but passed strict siting and water rules (Tech Backlash +0.02). Envision commissioned a gigawatt-scale AI campus in Ulanqab, China (Capability Velocity +0.03). Scores barely moved. Successors stayed the leading family. Horizon Balance held at -15.27.
movers_note: No ending moved more than 0.02. Benevolent Dictator, Protector God, Descendants and Self-Destruction each slipped 0.02 as earlier news faded.
